facts.fact: The first monsoon storm breaks about eight nights after ch14. Neela has twenty nights left and Devan says he has watched her for twenty days.
facts.why: needed because the beat requires 'twenty days' as witness, while ch14 had twenty-eight nights left and twelve days elapsed; a gap of about eight days reconciles them

facts.fact: For eight nights since the narrows, Neela as the other one has worked the ridge beyond the cut looking for whoever waits there; on the storm night she tracks two couriers with a pack pony and loses them in the rain.
facts.why: needed because the beat has her tracking couriers far down the ridge when the storm breaks

facts.fact: Neela keeps a plain six-inch guild knife in the gap between mattress and bed frame on her side.
facts.why: needed because the beat has her reach under the mattress for the knife

facts.fact: Devan has stated he deduced her purpose (sent to kill him) from the council-pressed match and her habits, and swore the silence offer on Asha's name; he asked for the name of whoever bought his death and offered it once.
facts.why: needed to carry the bargain beat
